intro.uz: Dilshod va Kamola tezyurar poyezdda Samarqandga boradi. Oʻqishdan oldin: siz qachon poyezdda yurgansiz?

paragraphs.en: It is Saturday morning. Dilshod and his sister Kamola are at the train station in Tashkent. They have two tickets for the Afrosiyob. It is a fast train.
paragraphs.uz: Shanba kuni ertalab. Dilshod va uning singlisi Kamola Toshkentdagi temir yoʻl vokzalida. Ularda «Afrosiyob»ga ikkita chipta bor. Bu — tezyurar poyezd.

paragraphs.en: The train leaves at eight o'clock. Their seats are next to a big window. The trip is about two hours. Kamola reads a book, and Dilshod looks at the fields and small villages.
paragraphs.uz: Poyezd soat sakkizda joʻnaydi. Ularning oʻrindiqlari katta derazaning yonida. Yoʻl taxminan ikki soat davom etadi. Kamola kitob oʻqiydi, Dilshod esa dalalar va kichik qishloqlarga qaraydi.

paragraphs.en: There is a small café on the train. Dilshod would like a cup of tea. Kamola would like some water and a sandwich.
paragraphs.uz: Poyezdda kichik kafe bor. Dilshod bir piyola choy ichmoqchi. Kamola esa suv va sendvich olmoqchi.

paragraphs.en: In Samarkand, their uncle Jahongir is at the station. He says, "Welcome to Samarkand!" Tomorrow they want to see the Registan.
paragraphs.uz: Samarqandda vokzalda ularni amakisi Jahongir kutib turibdi. U: «Samarqandga xush kelibsizlar!» — deydi. Ertaga ular Registonni koʻrmoqchi.

grammar.example: The train leaves at eight o'clock.
Dilshod would like a cup of tea.
